title: Trigonocephaly-associated hypotelorism: an assessment of orbital shapes and dimensions
html: Trigonocephaly occurs due to the premature fusion of the metopic suture. The aim of this study was to document the orbital morphometry of patients with trigonocephaly compared to controls, and to classify the different morphological appearances of the orbits in trigonocephaly. Preoperative two-dimensional computed tomography scans of 15 patients with non-syndromic isolated trigonocephaly (13 male, two female; median age 11 months) and eight controls (four male, four female; median age 22 months) were digitized and analysed.
